title: A chain of processes
summary: Each process creates the next one and waits for it.
hints: Write a function `level(k, n)`: print `down k`, flush, and if `k < n` create a child that calls `level(k + 1, n)` and then exits; the parent waits; finally print `up k`.
`fflush(stdout)` before every `fork`, or the pending output is copied into the child.
